name: dapp
description: Reference full-stack DApp: Hardhat (contracts) + Express/PostgreSQL (backend) + React (frontend), all TypeScript

scripts.test: npm run test -w contracts && npm run test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w contracts && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
